atoms.b: After years of dealing with raids and paying large amounts of ((++Danegeld buttons)), Aethelred wanted to show his authority.
atoms.sound: After years of dealing with raids and paying large amounts of Dane-geld, Ethelred wanted to show his authority.

atoms.b: In 1002, he ordered a mass killing of the ((++Danes Spaniards)) living in English territory. This was called the St Brice’s Day massacre.
atoms.sound: In 10 O2, he ordered a mass killing of the Danes living in English territory. This was called the St Brice’s Day massacre.

atoms.b: Archaeologists have uncovered mass graves which tell us that ((++hundreds_of no)) Danes died in this massacre.

feedback.end: This is Sweyn Forkbeard, King of Denmark. His sister was killed in the St Brice’s Day massacre, so Sweyn took revenge by launching a series of raids in England.

end.text: Between 1002 and 1013, Aethelred tried to pay off the Vikings once again with more than 38,000 kg of silver. This made England very poor.
end.sound: Between 10 O2 and 10 13, Ethelred tried to pay off the Vikings once again with more than 38,000 kg of silver. This made England very poor.

atoms.b: By 1013, England had very little ((++money grass)) and was unable to protect itself.
atoms.sound: By 10 13, England had very little money and was unable to protect itself.

atoms.b: When Sweyn launched a large scale invasion that year, he easily took the ((++throne biscuit)) and captured several important English cities. Sweyn was the first Viking King of England.
atoms.sound: When Sweyn launched a large scale invasion that year, he easily took the throne and captured several important English cities. Sweyn was the first Viking King of England.
